reviews.text: Paradise for four-legged friends

Hello Pierre,

Thank you for your visit and your 4-star rating. We are delighted that your experience at Animalis Paris 2 - Quatre Septembre was positive.

We look forward to seeing you again in store soon!

Sincerely,
The Animalis Paris 2 - Quatre Septembre Team
Very welcoming store, attentive staff
Broken door. I tripped over that huge piece of metal... the person in charge didn't even apologize! Shameful!

I occasionally shop at this store. The cashiers were polite until I got to the checkout, where I had to put my own items in the paper bag… is it really that difficult to serve a customer from start to finish?
Excellent service, very friendly and welcoming cashier.

A huge thank you to Jérémy and the whole team for their help! We had a serious problem with ants getting into our dog's food bags for a long time. Jérémy really took the time to find a solution tailored to our problem and helped us solve it.

Thank you so much for your kindness and help 😊
Excellent and very friendly.
Much worse than the one in Courbevoie, many products missing, but also salespeople who were either absent or unable to inform you about the availability of a product, or any alternative...

The saleswoman was extremely unpleasant and aggressive. It just seemed like she didn't want to be there.

I've been shopping there for my dog ​​for several days now, but every time I see this particular saleswoman, I don't even want to go in anymore.

How can management allow this kind of behavior???

❌ Avoid at all costs. Hostile, racist, and dangerous behavior from the cashier.

Today (June 19th) around 7:20 PM, I entered the store alone just after another customer had left. The cashier told me, "We're closing in 10 minutes." I don't speak perfect French. When I expressed my surprise, "10 minutes?", she replied in an extremely haughty and aggressive manner, "Yes, if you know what that is."

I only stayed for a minute or two so as not to disturb her. But when I tried to leave, the cashier had deliberately lowered the metal gate, blocking the main door and preventing me from leaving freely. There were two cashiers at the register. One was acting with blatant hostility, while the other watched the scene without intervening.

I had to wait until she deigned to raise it.

After leaving, I realized how hostile and dangerous this behavior was. Being trapped like that caused me immense stress and profound discomfort.

This experience left me with a very unpleasant feeling. Blocking the door with a customer inside is a major safety violation, and I could have called the police.

I came to the store so I could buy a Parisian toy to my dog and was welcomed by a young saleswoman named Katherine she was so kind and nice and spoke to me in English when she saw me struggling with my French, she showed me a variety of things I could get.
It was so nice of her and ended up not 1 but 2 toys for my baby dog
Thank you to make my week in Paris even better Katherine.

Dear Juan Diego de Haro Castillo,

Thank you so much for your five-star review! We are delighted to hear that your experience at Animalis Paris 2 - Quatre Septembre was so positive. Our team works every day to provide the best possible service, and your feedback is truly encouraging.

Please don't hesitate to come back and see us; we will always be happy to welcome you and assist you with your pet's needs.

Sincerely,

The Animalis Paris 2 - Quatre Septembre Team
No restocking. Out of stock for 3 weeks. We have to find another way to manage things after a while...
Pleasant experience

The store has a wide selection and stock available for 2-hour pickup. Unfortunately, the quality of the staff is highly variable.

First visit in December: a warm welcome despite the high volume of customers due to the holidays, with a gentleman who was very helpful and patient.

Second visit in March: two people in the store and two women at the registers who complained loudly about their team and superiors without making any attempt to be discreet or helpful. In the end, the service at the register was cold and bossy, and they refused to let me collect my order (which had already been paid for, and I had received a text message confirmation) before I had paid for the additional items I wanted. All I was trying to do was get an idea of ​​whether I could wear everything. The apologies seemed more aggressive than sincere.

Dear FEEL EVASION,

We sincerely thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us and for giving us a 5-star rating. Your satisfaction is our priority, and knowing that we met your expectations fills us with joy.

We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back to Animalis Paris 2 - Quatre Septembre and to offer you the same level of satisfaction on your next visit.

Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions or require further information.

Thank you again, FEEL EVASION, for your support and trust.

Sincerely,

The Animalis Paris 2 - Quatre Septembre Team

Dear Marie-Amélie S,

Thank you so much for your review and for the four stars you awarded Animalis Paris 2 - Quatre Septembre. It is very important to us that our guests have a pleasant experience at our establishment.

If you have any suggestions or additional comments that could help us make your next visit an even more enjoyable experience, please do not hesitate to share them with us. Your feedback is invaluable for our continuous improvement.

We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back very soon.

Sincerely,
The Animalis Paris 2 - Quatre Septembre Team
Friendly staff
Laurent's welcome was excellent.
I love this store
They always treat me wonderfully, they remember the customer and on special occasions they've even given me a small gift for my little Lulus
Wide selection of cat-related products. Friendly welcome.
A store with a wide variety of brands and prices. Friendly staff.
The product I'm looking for is always out of stock ㅠ

One disappointing experience after another. First, one saleswoman was unbearably rude; you'd think she was doing you a favor by speaking to you.

I came to pick up items listed as available for in-store pickup on the website. When I explained my presence, she curtly replied, asking me if I thought I knew more than she did.

Another time, I went to exchange some items, and her colleague told me, "Just choose what you want in exchange and present your receipt at the register." Which I did. The other woman then claimed that the receipt didn't prove the original purchase, alleging that I might have stolen the items. She insinuated this in front of a whole line of customers. It was humiliating and unacceptable, especially since I had the receipt in my hand.

And finally, deliveries are systematically delayed by several days, which is unacceptable when it comes to food for our animals.

This Wednesday morning, we received an exceptional welcome from the saleswoman who opened the store. She was incredibly kind and genuinely caring. Unfortunately, I don't know her first name, but her professionalism, patience, and dedication to customer service made this a particularly pleasant experience. It's a real pleasure to encounter such thoughtful shopkeepers.

I went in today, January 13th. The welcome and manner of speaking were very pleasant. The saleswoman asked me several times for my account information. She couldn't find me. I offered to give her my phone number, but she refused. Finally, she said, "Okay, that's fine," to move on to something else. But since I knew she hadn't credited me with loyalty points, I asked for my receipt. "Oh, it's not on your receipt," she said. So she ended up taking my phone number. What kind of attitude is that? If she doesn't want to work, she should leave her job...

Hello, on January 8, 2026,

I went to the ANIMALIS store in the 2nd arrondissement of Paris.

The store opens at 10:00 AM, but the manager arrived late at 10:15 AM. The manager then ushered us out into the cold. As customers, we were very disappointed with the service and the image this store projects.

In the end, it opened at 10:20 AM instead of the usual 10:00 AM.

Not only did she reprimand her employee in front of the customers, which is very unprofessional, but this woman also told us that it was impossible to make any purchases because the cash register wasn't working.

In short, an arrogant and irritable manager, an unpleasant woman – a negative review.

I'm forced to give one star, which it doesn't even deserve. The store looks like it's been abandoned, with merchandise scattered everywhere, no organization whatsoever, and I think the woman in question should tidy up and put in more effort. A friend came by earlier and told me she was unhappy, but I preferred to see for myself.

I can confirm, I fully intend to speak to the manager.

The atmosphere was icy; we were clearly bothering this woman.
Does this woman even like animals? I don't think so at all.
There are plenty of Animalis stores; I don't recommend this one.
Just dogs and cats, good welcome.

A pet shop that can be useful in a pinch for kibble and toys. But it's rather poorly organized, and the customer experience isn't very pleasant. The shelves aren't very well stocked. I couldn't find anything to spoil my dogs. But I understand it could be handy when you've run out of kibble at home.

I placed a click & collect order with 2-hour delivery, but haven't heard anything. I've called and emailed, but two weeks later, still nothing. The store says the item is in stock, and I've already paid. No delivery deadlines are being met; this is false advertising!
Nylabone brand toy for my super resilient Malinois 💪 …

Perfect! I had a great chat with Eric, a really nice guy who gave excellent advice. Thanks to him, I left with a happy cat kit 🐱 and a seasoned owner's kit.
Happy holidays to you! …
Vast selection of mostly american brands, but stocks the boring essentials you need if traveling with pets, specifically the muzzles required on the TGV
Excellent experience and very pleasant staff
Great pet shop. You can find all the essentials here! Convenient location :)
Great shop, great team.
The seller was quick and efficient. I found the Royal Canin puppy treats that are unavailable for online ordering.

I highly recommend this place. The staff are helpful, very available, and friendly (only one person was unpleasant, but it didn't reflect well on the store). One person spent a lot of time advising me, and I'm extremely grateful. Seriously, go there!
Good salesperson who advised us on the choice of products we were looking for.
Give a shout-out to the young man named Ayden (sorry if I misspelled it). He's great! He helped me and gave me advice on a dog coat, and he was really patient with me. Thank you!! Hooray for Ayden!

I stopped by at the end of the day, but unfortunately the dog treats I wanted were out of stock even though they were listed as available on the website. The store is clean and well-organized. The salesperson was really lovely and helpful.
Thanks to Guillaume for his advice :)!
The staff are very friendly. The advisor will be happy to advise you and help you with your choice.
It's a great store

Warm welcome, excellent advice.
He gave me great tips for my dog. Super nice, plus he gave him a free chicken chip. The best part is that it's right next to my house. I love this shop! 🥰 …

So disappointed with the service 😢 I used to go there almost every three weeks. I was always very well received and especially given great advice. But this past Thursday, October 2nd, in the late afternoon, I asked a woman who was there restocking the shelves for advice. She wasn't empathetic at all; I felt like I was bothering her just by saying hello. She was fed up with answering my questions and even more so with recommending products. It's such a shame because I really liked the staff and I only went to this particular pet store. I made it very clear to her that she wasn't being friendly!
Unfortunately, I won't be coming back to your store 💔

Cold and unpleasant welcome.
No help offered.
The store is poorly stocked and disorganized.

Order placed on the website on September 25, 2025, for click and collect within 2 hours. Having received no updates, I called the store. A woman told me to wait.

After 3 hours, I received a text message to pick up my order. I received a frosty reception in the store from the same woman, who I was clearly bothering.

In short, this Paris store is best avoided.
I just hope this person doesn't hate animals as much as she hates people!
